# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the current default branch. Historical device
images, captures, and revisions are retained as reference material and are not
independently supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use this repository's **Report a vulnerability** link on GitHub to submit a
private vulnerability report. Do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities in a
public issue, discussion, pull request, or social-media post.

Include the affected script or artifact, device/build context, reproduction
steps, security impact, and safe supporting evidence. Never include device
credentials, private keys, personal data, or proprietary third-party material.

The maintainer will acknowledge a complete report, assess its scope, and
coordinate remediation and disclosure through the private report.
